summary: This directory manages the construction and organization of structured content components. It encapsulates the logic required to assemble individual pieces of a document into a coherent, hierarchical format suitable for further processing or rendering.
responsibilities: Assemble individual content segments into structured sections
Define the logical arrangement of document components
Verify the integrity of constructed document structures
relationships: The Content Builder processes individual components to form a unified Document Structure.
Section Assembly defines the hierarchy that governs how content components are combined.
designDecisions: Uses a builder pattern to decouple component creation from document structure assembly
Enforces structural validation during the building process
